senses.gloss: to come in contact, touch, be connected. Denom. גַּיָּיס; גִּיס. [Ukts. II, 6 שיגוס, v. נָגַס.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:11">Makhsh. V, 11</cite> <he>מֵגִיסָה בקדרה</he> she stirs the pot.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:1">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> top <he>ומֵגִיסָה</he> and may stir it.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 67b:8">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>המגיס בפני אפרוחים</he> (missing in Ms.) who stirs a dish before chickens (a superstitious practice).
